title: Existing fixed-coordinate finite-ring projection invertibility
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring in Type (u+1), X and Y schemes in Type u, f : X → Y and c a compactification. Let K and L be objects of the unbounded pro-etale derived categories of ModuleCat Λ. Suppose K has bounded constructible etale origin and L has bounded constructible etale origin and finite Tor amplitude, using the predicates of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Then the canonical proper/open compactification projection [def-exchange-projection], (Rf_! K) tensor L → Rf_!(K tensor Lf*L), is an isomorphism. No Tor condition on K or structure-map separatedness is required. This is the existing source theorem named in lean, with no new Lean declaration.

proof.text: Use the bounded constructible etale origins K0,L0 and their comparison isomorphisms. Boundedness of K and the second input Tor interval show that the open extension of K0 tensored with the proper-factor pullback of L0 is bounded below. The existing source proof does this with plus_derivedTensor_leftDerivedUpperStar_of_comparison; no Tor interval for K is used.

The finite-ring etale proper projection theorem makes the proper-factor projection invertible. Its geometric-stalk argument is the finite formula in the unit route. The normalized proper comparison carries this map to the pro-etale proper map on the retained etale origins.

Comparison commutes with extension by zero. Compose the proper projection with the inverse canonical open tensor projection and the compactification pullback comparison. Each factor is invertible, so their specified composite is invertible. This is exactly the already proved source theorem, not an alternative projection arrow.
